scripts.build: bun build extension/src/content.ts extension/src/background.ts extension/src/popup.ts --outdir extension/dist --target browser
scripts.build:prod: bun build extension/src/content.ts extension/src/background.ts extension/src/popup.ts --outdir extension/dist --target browser --minify --sourcemap=none
scripts.package: bun run build:prod && bunx web-ext build --source-dir extension --ignore-files "src/**" --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: bun run build:prod && bunx web-ext sign --source-dir extension --ignore-files "src/**" --channel unlisted
